{{Quote|The Jedi who persuaded me to join the Order, she was Human|[[Juhani]]|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
A '''female Human''' was among the many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who defied the orders of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|High Council]] and went to the aid of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

==History==
===Liberation of Taris===
{{Quote|But the Jedi came and ruined everything!|[[Xor]]|<ref name="KotOR" />}}
[[File:Juhani_crop.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Juhani]] was spured on to become a Jedi due to the kindness of one particular Human woman]]
During the latter stages of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Revanchist|those]] loyal to him led a campaign to liberate the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] world of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] from [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian]] occupation. While on Taris the Jedi drove the [[Exchange]] from the planet, and freed many of the [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] they were holding, including a young [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] girl named [[Juhani]]. Recognizing the girl's potential with [[The Force/Legends|The Force]] one of the Jedi persuaded Juhani to travel to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and seek out the Jedi for training, which she did.<ref name="KotOR" />

==Appearances==
